component.name: Herd
component.summary: Manage local inference models with a COSMIC app and panel companion

description.p: Herd manages local models through native llama.cpp and Colibri controls. Its COSMIC application provides engine selection, sidebar navigation and a model settings drawer; the panel companion offers quick controls and status.

Process Compose hosts inference and transfers independently of UI lifetime. Existing weights are reused without implicit downloads or model eviction. Native CPU, GPU, context and cache settings remain available for fine tuning.

Public Hugging Face search and file review support explicitly confirmed single-file GGUF downloads through llama.cpp, with progress, pause/resume and integrity checks before loading. Colibri uses its native multi-file catalogue and downloader with explicit acquisition review. Downloading never starts inference.
